head: a04e11a
phase: P06 - Local-model router and quality policy (complete)
method: Semantic subject-to-module mapping validated against a production import-reachability graph, executed tests separated from source-text assertions, and executed gate results. Source-text assertions are graded SOURCE COMPLETE, never UNIT TESTED.

requirements.subject: Local-first governed product definition — OCADE remains a local-first, permission-governed operating layer spanning Chat, Logic, Copilot/Cowork, browser, desktop, mobile, voice, research, code workspaces, application learning, security, evidence, recovery, packaging, and operations without hiding where processing occurs.

Live repository and retained evidence are authoritative — Every completion claim is verified against the live repository, executable tests, build output, runtime observations, checkpoints, handoffs, and retained evidence; documentation alone is insufficient.
requirements.evidence: 773 paths committed in 10 reviewable path-scoped commits and pushed; remote HEAD b3ed79d matches local exactly; retained evidence in release/ regenerated from executed output

requirements.subject: Evidence ladder and honest status classification — Every requirement uses the defined evidence classes and never conflates source existence, tests, simulation, real runtime, external blockers, or production readiness.
Historical baseline must be revalidated — Historical percentages, test counts, branch data, and HEAD values may be carried forward only after current command output independently confirms them.
requirements.evidence: historical 3,474-test and 24-gate claims revalidated against current output and corrected

requirements.subject: Original-core and expanded-programme scopes remain separate — Completion is recalculated separately for the original core and the expanded marketplace, enterprise, telemetry, bounty, public-proof, release, and hardware-elimination scope.

Mandatory requirement-to-code traceability — The audit produces exact counts, owners, files, tests, commands, dependencies, defects, evidence, acceptance tests, and a dependency-ordered execution roadmap.

Non-destructive repository preservation — Planning and audit work does not reset, clean, stash, discard, switch worktrees, delete untracked work, mass-format, commit, push, merge, rebase, apply live migrations, modify real credentials, sign, publish, or deploy without approval.
requirements.evidence: no reset, clean, stash, force-push, merge or rebase; full worktree backup taken before any change; fast-forward push only, after owner approval

requirements.subject: Universal governed loop and control hierarchy — Consequential work follows observe, understand, plan, validate, risk, permission, deterministic execution, independent verification, receipt, recovery, and trusted continuation while preferring API, plug-in, CLI, file, DOM, accessibility, native, vision, then scoped input.

Systematic hardware and tooling blocker reduction — A blocker is genuinely external only after portable runtimes, hosted runners, emulators, free equivalents, existing devices, authorised remote workers, peer-to-peer paths, signed external evidence, community skills, and one-step human actions have been evaluated.

Validation, readiness, and handoff contract — Every change passes focused and full validation, production readiness requires real target evidence and operations, and every handoff records exact repository state, tests, blockers, next file, next command, expected output, and required approvals.
